data.name: Erich
data.gender_notes: Erich is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old Germanic words 'ari' (eagle, ruler) and 'hric' (power, ruler). The name Erich was borne by several European rulers and saints. The name Erich carries the meaning “Ruler, Powerful One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Erich usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, powerful one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Erich belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler, Powerful One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erich total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אריך
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אריך הוא שם שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית ומשמעותו 'אדם חזק ומנהיג העם'. השם אריך נגזר מהמילים הגרמניות 'Erich', שמשמעותן 'שליט העם' או 'מנהיג חזק'. למרות שלא מופיע ישירות בתנ"ך, השם אריך מייצג תכונות של חוזק, מנהיגות ואמינות, שהן מרכזיות בערכים הנוצרים.

in_greek.name: Ερίχ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ερίχ προέρχεται από τη Γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ισχυρός Άρχων του Λαού'. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Ερίχ συνδέεται με τις έννοιες της δύναμης, της ηγεσίας και της προστασίας, που είναι θεμελιώδεις για την χριστιανική πίστη. Αν και δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα στη Βίβλο, το Ερίχ αντανακλά τις αξίες της δύναμης και της ηγεσίας.

in_latin.name: Erich
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Erich origine Germanica ortum est et significat 'Princeps Populi Fortis' seu 'Dux Populi Validus'. In traditione christiana, nomen Erich virtutes fortitudinis, leadership et fidelitatis repraesentat, quae sunt fundamentalia in doctrina christiana. Quamquam non directe in Bibliis apparet, Erich est nomen quod qualitates fortes et principes populi denotat.

in_english.name: Erich
in_english.long_meaning: The name Erich, originating from Germanic roots, signifies 'Strong Ruler of the People' or 'Powerful Leader'. Derived from the Germanic words 'Erich', meaning 'ruler of the people' or 'strong leader', Erich embodies qualities of strength, leadership, and reliability. Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, Erich reflects Christian values of strong leadership and faithfulness. Historically, the name Erich has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing courage and steadfastness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Erich has been closely associated with European royalty and military leadership throughout history. With its strong connotations of power, might, and rule, it has long been admired and coveted as an impressive and noble name.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian symbolism, the name Erich can represent the power and strength of God, evoking the imagery of the eagle soaring through the heavens or the powerful reign of a just and revered ruler over God's people. It serves as a reminder of the spiritual blessings we receive from a loving and protective God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Erich: Meaning rich in power or ruler, symbolizing strength and leadership in spiritual or personal pursuits.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Erich of Dynan (d. 1189) was a German nobleman and crusader who participated in the Third Crusade. The name Erich carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
Erich of Mecklenburg (1240–1272) was a Duke of Mecklenburg and a crusader who took part in the Seventh Crusade.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Erich remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Peter Erich, a minister in Jerusalem, Israel, shares that their name Erich meaning "Ruler, Powerful One" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
